schema: nc-1 signal weights v1 (pre-registered, Linguist R2, c.6552176904)
density: signal_units / tokens (records stratum: records_density element-level variant, keys excluded)
novelty: novel = first occurrence within the evaluation window; restated signal within the window scores 0 (restatement penalty). v1 corpus units are independent single-unit windows, so no within-unit restatement adjustment applies; disclosed in corpus README.
operationalization_v1: reference extractor (scripts/doe/nc1_features.py) approximates weight-1 elements at token granularity; R3 adjacency is applied in minimal form at the label level in v1 and as a full feature in v2 (claim<->ref adjacency, Linguist canonical def c.6552176904).
